description: This file contains an HTML web page that demonstrates the use of Isomorphic SmartClient components such as Menus, Canvas, and Image, with embedded JavaScript code to create and manipulate UI widgets like images and menu items.

methods.name: moveUp
methods.description: Moves the widget upward by 20 pixels, ensuring it doesn't go beyond a top boundary.

methods.name: moveRight
methods.description: Moves the widget to the right by 20 pixels, ensuring it doesn't go beyond a right boundary.

methods.name: moveDown
methods.description: Moves the widget downward by 20 pixels, ensuring it stays within the lower boundary.

methods.name: moveLeft
methods.description: Moves the widget leftward by 20 pixels, ensuring it doesn't cross the left boundary.
